pools.name: Farrelly Pool
pools.operator: City of San Leandro Recreation & Human Services
pools.notes: Heated outdoor pool. Seasonal (typically late May–early September). 7 lap lanes. Offers recreational swim and lap swim.

pools.name: San Leandro Family Aquatic Center
pools.operator: City of San Leandro Recreation & Human Services
pools.notes: Seasonal outdoor water park (opens mid-June, closes late September). Zero-depth entry activity pool with water play structure. 3 lap lanes. Family-focused.

pools.name: Emma Hood Swim Center
pools.notes: Outdoor heated pool at Oak Street and Alameda Avenue. Summer 2026 public swim schedule listed as 'Coming Soon' as of June 2026.

pools.name: Encinal Swim Center
pools.notes: Outdoor pool. Summer 2026 public swim schedule listed as 'Coming Soon' as of June 2026.

pools.name: deFremery Pool
pools.notes: Seasonal outdoor pool. Opens around mid-June. Summer 2026 rec swim hours: Sat–Sun 12:00–4:00 pm (confirmed for summer season).

pools.name: Fremont Pool
pools.notes: Outdoor pool near Fremont High School. Opened April 11 2026. Contact: FremontPool@oaklandca.gov, (510) 535-5614.

pools.name: Temescal Pool
pools.notes: Outdoor pool at Oakland Technical High School. Contact: TemescalPool@oaklandca.gov.

pools.name: Larry E. Reid Sports Center Pool
pools.notes: Indoor 9,000 sq ft water park with white water slide, activity pools, beach entry pool, lazy river. Also known as East Oakland Sports Center Pool. Aquatic Playtime M-F for ages 6 and under. Weekday-only rec access as of 2026. Contact: (510) 615-5838.

pools.name: Piedmont Community Pool
pools.notes: Newly reconstructed pool opened April 11, 2026. Has both Competition Pool (50m) and Activity Pool. Drop-in $5. Summer hours start June 8. Contact: (510) 420-3090.

pools.name: Emeryville Center of Community Life Pool
pools.notes: Also known as Steve Dain Drive address. Outdoor pool. Rec swim season June 22 – Aug 14, 2026. Ages under 4 free. Drop-in: adults $6, kids 5-17 $4.

pools.name: King Pool
pools.operator: City of Berkeley Parks, Recreation & Waterfront
pools.notes: Outdoor heated pool in North Berkeley. Community Swim (all ages, entire pool) offered summer only. Family Swim (shallow pool, all ages) offered year-round. All drop-in participants must pre-pay. Summer schedule PDF not yet published as of June 11, 2026; spring schedule runs through June 7. Contact: (510) 981-5105.

pools.name: West Campus Pool
pools.operator: City of Berkeley Parks, Recreation & Waterfront
pools.notes: Outdoor heated pool in West Berkeley. Summer only. Community Swim and Family Swim offered daily during summer. Closed June 6-7 for staff training, reopens June 8. All drop-in must pre-pay. Summer 2026 schedule PDF not yet indexed as of June 11.

pools.name: Albany Aquatic Center
pools.operator: Albany Unified School District / City of Albany
pools.notes: Indoor pool at Albany High School. Offers Family Play Time (rec swim). ActiveNet registration system. 2026 closure dates: 6/12, 6/19, 7/3, 7/4, 8/9. Reduced lanes 6/26. Contact: (510) 559-6640.
